EmailTemplate.description: Used to alert users when SF will be down.
EmailTemplate.name: Notice to All Users - Outage
EmailTemplate.subject: Salesforce Offline Notice
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Salesforce will be unavailable (off-line) on Friday, July 18 from 11:00 pm to 11:05 pm for regular maintenance.
How will this affect you?
You will not be able to login to Salesforce during this time and will need to re-enter your login credentials once the maintenance has completed.
This maintenance window is for the production instance of Salesforce only, not the sandbox instances.
Salesforce is updating to the Summer '14 release. You may notice small changes once back online.
What about public facing sites?
Public facing sites such as the public knowledge base accessible from MyASU and RFI forms will not be available during this time.
How do I get help if something doesn’t work correctly?
You can use the Chatter function to post a question or you can send a email to salesforce.support@asu.edu.
